questions.q: In "Know the yard, the plants and the tools Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Check what insurance a business like yours is asked to hold; talk to a licensed insurance adviser.
Name the parts of a yard: lawn, beds, trees, shrubs, paths, edges and drainage.

Compute the area of a bed (length x width) to find how much mulch or soil you need.
